:::{#thm-nb-mixture-moments}
#### Moments of a Poisson mixture

Let $\Lambda$ be a positive random variable with mean $\mu$ and variance $\mu^2 / \rho$,
for constants $\mu > 0$ and $\rho > 0$,
and suppose that,
given $\Lambda$,
$Y$ has a [Poisson distribution](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/distributions.html#def-poisson) with mean $\Lambda$:
$Y \mid \Lambda \sim \Pois(\Lambda)$.
Then:

$$
\E{Y} = \mu,
\qquad
\Var{Y} = \mu + \frac{\mu^2}{\rho}
$$ {#eq-nb-mixture-moments}

which are the mean and the variance @eq-nb-reg-var that a negative binomial regression model (@def-nb-reg)
specifies for a covariate pattern and exposure with mean $\mu$.
:::
